id: title:Gilbert09:skip zones that reject the page rules api

review.posthog_relevance: Supports warehouse ingestion compatibility with Cloudflare by allowing the ingestion pipeline to skip 400 status responses from deprecated Page Rules, preventing ingestion failures during Cloudflare's transition to the Ruleset Engine.
review.reason: Adds a 400 status code to the list of skipped status codes for Cloudflare zone listing and updates warehouse ingestion compatibility tests to expect 400 status for pagerules. This is a narrow, localized maintenance and compatibility improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on Cloudflare's API behavior and the specific warehouse configurations PostHog customers use; this does not prove widespread adoption or incident avoidance.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds 400 to extra_skip_status_codes for Cloudflare zone listing, and adds pagerules to the list of 400-status zone features in the test.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows Cloudflare warehouse ingestion to skip zones returning 400 status when listing page rules, rather than treating them as empty or failing, supporting compatibility with Cloudflare's transition from Page Rules to Ruleset Engine.

observations.behavior: Adds pagerules to the list of zone features returning 400 status in the warehouse ingestion compatibility test.
observations.posthog_connection: Updates warehouse ingestion compatibility tests to expect 400 status for pagerules alongside other deprecated features, ensuring ingestion continues rather than aborting when a zone lacks the plan feature or has moved off a deprecated API.
